Summarize scrutiny objects

Source: R/audit.R
audit.Rd

audit() summarizes the output of scrutiny functions that test data frames, such as grim_map(). It is an S3 generic with methods for the functions listed below. The columns of each summary are described in the documentation of the respective function.

On the output of a sequence or total-n mapper, such as grim_map_seq(), it returns one row per case; see audit-special.

Usage

audit(data, ..., .by = NULL)

Arguments

data

A data frame returned by one of the functions below.

...

These dots must be empty.

.by

Optionally, columns of data to summarize by, selected as in dplyr::select(), such as .by = study. Each group is summarized on its own, and its rows start with the grouping columns. Groups appear in the order of their first row. Use this rather than dplyr::group_by(), which removes the class that audit() dispatches on.

Value

A tibble with summary statistics.

Run before audit()

FunctionClass
grim_map()"scrutiny_grim_map"
grimmer_map()"scrutiny_grimmer_map"
debit_map()"scrutiny_debit_map"
percentage_of_map()"scrutiny_percentage_of_map"
add_up_to_map()"scrutiny_add_up_to_map"
*_map_seq() functions"scrutiny_map_seq"
*_map_total_n() functions"scrutiny_map_total_n"
duplicate_count()"scrutiny_dup_count"
duplicate_count_colpair()"scrutiny_dup_count_colpair"
duplicate_tally()"scrutiny_dup_tally"
audit() on seq output"scrutiny_audit_seq"
audit() on total-n output"scrutiny_audit_total_n"

Examples

pigs1 |>
  grim_map(digits_x = 2, items_averaged = 1, data_type = "integer") |>
  audit()
#> # A tibble: 1 × 6
#>   all_cases testable_cases incon_cases emp_incon exp_incon ratio
#>       <int>          <int>       <int>     <dbl>     <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1        12             12           8     0.667     0.718 0.929

pigs4 |>
  duplicate_count() |>
  audit()
#> # A tibble: 2 × 8
#>   term         mean    sd median   min   max na_count na_rate
#>   <chr>       <dbl> <dbl>  <int> <int> <int>    <int>   <dbl>
#> 1 frequency    1.36 0.674      1     1     3        0       0
#> 2 locations_n  1.27 0.647      1     1     3        0       0

# Summaries by group:
pigs1 |>
  grim_map(digits_x = 2, items_averaged = 1, data_type = "integer") |>
  dplyr::mutate(study = rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 4)) |>
  audit(.by = study)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 7
#>   study all_cases testable_cases incon_cases emp_incon exp_incon ratio
#>   <chr>     <int>          <int>       <int>     <dbl>     <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 A             4              4           3      0.75     0.705 1.06 
#> 2 B             4              4           2      0.5      0.725 0.690
#> 3 C             4              4           3      0.75     0.722 1.04
